typical_cargo_types: Iron ore fines, coal, grains, steel products, minor bulks
source: Clarksons Research + UNCTAD Review of Maritime Transport + BIMCO
notes: Smallest dry-bulk class; flexible for shallow-draft ports like Haldia/Gopalpur; LOA/beam/draft are class-representative medians not single-vessel spec.
Often geared (cranes); Supramax/Ultramax 60-65k grouped here; beam ~32.3m fits Panamax beam limit historically.
Panamax beam limit 32.31m for old canal; LOA 294m max but typical bulk carrier 225m; draft ~13.5-14m.
Too large for Panama/Suez loaded; requires 17m+ draft; only Gangavaram/Dhamra/Paradip outer/Vizag outer on east coast can accommodate fully laden.
